profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Mantra Health
profile.summary: Full stack Software Engineer with a Front End and Javascript focus. Background in Civil Engineering and Project Management. Enthusiastic and experienced in the full software development lifecycle.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack developer working on a web app using Angular, Express, Node, and Postgres technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ruby on Rails Developer. Working with Postgres, JS/Coffeescript, JSON, AJAX, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for coordination, planning, and scheduling for project survey department
• Developed alignments and models in AutoCad Civil 3D for geometric take-offs and construction data
• Coordinated with project team to determine survey needs and controls on operational basis

positions.title: Project Scheduler
positions.description:
• Responsible for project progress documentation and communication to client
• Developed and executed multi-million dollar pay applications
• Created Time Impact Analysis Schedules to analyze the effects of delays to the project
• Further developed relationship skills through communication with client personnel
•  Developed internal methodology for tracking payment and progress

positions.title: Job Engineer
positions.description:
• Planned and organized field operations for Pontoon Construction, Float-Out., Fish Handling
• Supported field operations through planning, purchasing, and information coordination

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed major change order for design-related delay, including establishing merit
• Studied past pontoon construction costs on various projects to future price effects of changes and to provide a basis for labor inefficiency calculations

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
• Co-managed $900 million proposal for Dallas Horseshoe project
• Supervised development and production of SQL database for tracking and analyzing pursuits
• Communicated regularly with designers, estimators, proposal sponsors, and in-house proposal/marketing team to ensure information accuracy and deadline management
• Worked closely with graphic designers and technical writers to develop proposal documents
• Reviewed documents for quality control, accuracy, and RFP compliance
• Developed methodology and tracked relevant pursuit costs and metrics
